components.title: Article 50 Product Gate
components.description: Evaluates configured AI-interaction disclosure and machine-readable synthetic-content marking evidence while routing legal applicability to a qualified reviewer.

control-implementations.description: Organization-defined control identifiers referencing EU AI Act Article 50 obligations.

implemented-requirements.description: Test that the configured direct-interaction disclosure is present, timely, accessible, and evidenced.
Test that in-scope synthetic outputs carry machine-readable marking and that detectability evidence is retained.
